rewatch_engineering.loop_trick: Handwritten letter unfurls in first 3 seconds; folds back into identical closed shape in final 3 seconds
rewatch_engineering.hidden_detail: Date stamp on the letter reads 'Day 14 - first quiet day'. Only readable on a paused watch #2. Reframes the entire story
rewatch_engineering.punchline_reveal: Opens 'translated every English sentence' (loud, frustrated). Closes 'volume of his mind turned down' (silent, calm). Same brain, opposite state
rewatch_engineering.info_density: 6 years failed methods + 3 drills + total time + result + emotional payoff in 38s
rewatch_engineering.visual_rhythm: Calendar flips on the beat, accelerating from 1Hz to 2Hz as the protocol works

beats.visual: Cream paper unfurls into handwritten letter on dark background. Date stamp 'Day 14 - first quiet day' faintly visible bottom-right (8% opacity)
beats.caption: Diego translated | every sentence. | 6 YEARS.
beats.voice_line: Diego translated every English sentence for six years.

beats.visual: Quick montage on the beat: app icons / Zoom tutor / red-X test / meditation cushion
beats.caption: Apps. | Tutors. | Tests. | Meditation.
beats.voice_line: Apps. Tutors. Tests. Meditation. Nothing stopped his brain from doing it.

beats.visual: All cuts stop. Black frame with text fading in: 'Then he tried something different.'
beats.caption: Then he tried | something DIFFERENT.

beats.visual: Stopwatch shows 03:00. Three icons appear below: eye / hand / brain-image
beats.caption: 3 MIN/DAY | 3 DRILLS
beats.voice_line: Three minutes a day. Three simple drills.

beats.visual: Three quick scenes: POV naming objects in room / POV walking + verbs labeling / split screen English text replaced by image
beats.caption: 1. NAME | 2. NARRATE | 3. PICTURE
beats.voice_line: Name every object he saw. Narrate every action he did. Picture every sentence he heard.

beats.visual: Stopwatch counts to 42:00. Calendar pages blur-flip 14 days
beats.caption: 42 MIN | 14 DAYS
beats.voice_line: Total time. Forty-two minutes. Spread over fourteen days.

beats.visual: Two figures in conversation, soft golden light. Diego's thought bubble shows IMAGES instead of text
beats.caption: DAY 15: | first conversation. | NO translating.
beats.voice_line: On day fifteen, he had his first conversation in English without translating a single word.

beats.visual: Volume meter in corner of screen drops slowly to silence. Soft piano holds
beats.caption: Volume of his mind | TURNED DOWN.
beats.voice_line: He said it felt like the volume of his mind turned down.

beats.visual: Letter folds back into closed shape (matches opening). Final text overlay
beats.caption: 6 YEARS  vs  42 MIN | The METHOD won.
beats.voice_line: Six years. Forty-two minutes. The difference was the method.
